description: Elections Commission - Notice declaring W. A. Susanthasiri as a member of the Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Mahara Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's failure to attend meetings, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, specifically the nomination and declaration of a returned member by a political party and the Returning Officer. This falls under the Elections category (Type 7) as it deals with electoral procedures and declarations related to local authority elections.
